function backgroundLayersCase(v) {
  document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';
  const parent=document.createElement('main');document.body.append(parent);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.append(sheet);
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.id='target';parent.append(e);const s=getComputedStyle(e),checks={};
  const specs=[['background-attachment','backgroundAttachment','scroll',['scroll','fixed','local']],['background-origin','backgroundOrigin','padding-box',['border-box','padding-box','content-box']],['background-clip','backgroundClip','border-box',['border-box','padding-box','content-box','text','border-area']]];
  for(const [name,js,initial,values] of specs){
    parent.style.cssText='';const first=values[0],last=values[values.length-1],selected=values[v%values.length];
    const check=(key,css,expected,rules='')=>{sheet.textContent=rules;e.style.cssText='width:40px;height:10px;'+css;const box=e.getBoundingClientRect();checks[js+key]=s[js]===expected&&s.getPropertyValue(name)===expected&&box.width===40&&box.height===10;};
    check('Default','',initial);for(let i=0;i<values.length;i++)check('Keyword'+i,name+':'+values[i],values[i]);
    check('VariantLayers','background-image:'+Array(v%7+1).fill('none').join(',')+';'+name+':'+selected,Array(v%7+1).fill(selected).join(', '));
    check('Cycle','background-image:none,none,none;'+name+':'+first+','+last,[first,last,first].join(', '));check('Trim',name+':'+first+','+last,first);check('DefaultLayers','background-image:none,none,none',Array(3).fill(initial).join(', '));
    check('Variable','--layer:'+selected+';'+name+':var(--layer)',selected);check('Fallback',name+':var(--missing,'+last+')',last);check('InvalidVariable',name+':var(--missing)',initial);check('InvalidVariableValue','--layer:20px;'+name+':var(--layer)',initial);
    check('Specificity','',last,'div{'+name+':'+first+'}#target{'+name+':'+last+'}');check('SourceOrder','',last,'#target{'+name+':'+first+'}#target{'+name+':'+last+'}');check('Inline',name+':'+first,first,'#target{'+name+':'+last+'}');check('Important',name+':'+first,last,'#target{'+name+':'+last+'!important}');
    check('Layers','',last,'@layer early,late;@layer early{#target{'+name+':'+first+'}}@layer late{div{'+name+':'+last+'}}');check('ImportantLayers','',first,'@layer early,late;@layer early{div{'+name+':'+first+'!important}}@layer late{#target{'+name+':'+last+'!important}}');
    sheet.textContent='';parent.style.setProperty(name,first+','+last);check('NotInherited','',initial);check('InheritTrim','background-image:none,none,none;'+name+':inherit',Array(3).fill(first).join(', '));parent.style.backgroundImage='none,none,none';check('InheritUnexpanded','background-image:none,none,none,none,none;'+name+':inherit',[first,last,first,last,first].join(', '));parent.style.backgroundImage='none';checks[js+'LiveParentCount']=s[js]===Array(5).fill(first).join(', ');
    check('Unset',name+':unset',initial);check('Initial',name+':initial',initial);check('Revert',name+':revert',initial);check('Registered',name+':var(--registered)',last,'@property --registered{syntax:"<custom-ident>";inherits:false;initial-value:'+last+'}');check('Uppercase',name+':'+last.toUpperCase(),last);check('Escaped',name+':'+first+';'+name+':'+String.fromCharCode(92)+last.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)+' '+last.slice(1),last);
    sheet.textContent='';e.style.cssText=name+':'+last;e.style.setProperty(name,'20px');checks[js+'Invalid']=s[js]===last;e.style.setProperty(name,first+' '+last);checks[js+'InvalidPair']=s[js]===last;e.style.setProperty(name,first+',');checks[js+'InvalidList']=s[js]===last;
    e.style.setProperty(name.toUpperCase(),first,'important');checks[js+'Cssom']=s[js]===first&&e.style.getPropertyPriority(name)==='important';checks[js+'Removal']=e.style.removeProperty(name)===first&&s[js]===initial;
    e.style.cssText=name+':'+first+','+last;checks[js+'LiveTrim']=s[js]===first;e.style.backgroundImage='none,none,none';checks[js+'LiveImageCount']=s[js]===[first,last,first].join(', ');e.style.setProperty(name,last);checks[js+'LiveValue']=s[js]===Array(3).fill(last).join(', ');
    e.style.cssText='';sheet.textContent='#target{'+name+':'+first+'}';checks[js+'LiveSheet']=s[js]===first;sheet.textContent='#target{'+name+':'+last+'}';checks[js+'LiveSheetMutation']=s[js]===last;
    sheet.textContent='';const throws=(fn)=>{try{fn();return false;}catch(e){return e.name==='NoModificationAllowedError';}};checks[js+'ReadOnly']=throws(()=>{s[js]=first});checks[js+'Priority']=s.getPropertyPriority(name)==='';checks[js+'UppercaseRead']=s.getPropertyValue(name.toUpperCase())===initial;checks[js+'Enumeration']=Array.from({length:s.length},(_,i)=>s.item(i)).filter(value=>value===name).length===1;
    e.remove();checks[js+'Detached']=s[js]==='';parent.append(e);checks[js+'Reattached']=s[js]===initial;
  }
  const external=document.createElement('div');external.id='external';parent.append(external);const x=getComputedStyle(external);checks.external=x.backgroundAttachment===(v%2?'local':'fixed')&&x.backgroundOrigin==='content-box'&&x.backgroundClip==='padding-box';
  e.style.background='none fixed content-box padding-box';checks.shorthand=s.backgroundAttachment==='fixed'&&s.backgroundOrigin==='content-box'&&s.backgroundClip==='padding-box';e.style.background='none';checks.shorthandReset=s.backgroundAttachment==='scroll'&&s.backgroundOrigin==='padding-box'&&s.backgroundClip==='border-box';
  e.style.cssText='background-clip:border-area text';checks.clipCombined=s.backgroundClip==='border-area text';e.style.backgroundClip='text border-area';checks.clipCombinedReverse=s.backgroundClip==='border-area text';e.style.backgroundClip='text text';checks.clipDuplicateIgnored=s.backgroundClip==='border-area text';e.style.backgroundClip='border-box text';checks.clipMixedBoxIgnored=s.backgroundClip==='border-area text';e.style.cssText='background-image:none,none;--clip:text border-area;background-clip:var(--clip)';checks.clipCombinedLayers=s.backgroundClip==='border-area text, border-area text';
  e.style.cssText='';e.style.backgroundClip='padding-box';e.style.backgroundClip='border';checks.invalidLegacyClip=s.backgroundClip==='padding-box';sheet.remove();return checks;
}
